name: Mortgage delinquency by county and state (CFPB Mortgage Performance Trends), monthly from 2008
description: The share of mortgages 90 or more days delinquent and 30 to 89 days delinquent, from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau's Mortgage Performance Trends, for the nation, every state and DC and each county the CFPB publishes (counties with at least 1,000 mortgages in its sample): the latest month, the same month a year earlier, the change in percentage points, the highest and lowest 90-day share since January 2008 and each year's December values. Percents only, as the CFPB publishes them.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Mortgage delinquency by county and state (CFPB Mortgage Performance Trends), monthly from 2008 (Version 1.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24116047
keywords: mortgages behind on payments by county

distribution.name: mortgage-delinquency.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: mortgage-delinquency.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

recordSet.name: mortgage-delinquency
recordSet.description: The records of Mortgage delinquency by county and state (CFPB Mortgage Performance Trends), monthly from 2008, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code (50 states and DC), or US

field.name: level
field.description: us, state or county

field.name: area
field.description: US, the 2-digit state FIPS code or the 5-digit county FIPS code

field.name: areaName
field.description: County and state, state name, or United States

field.name: stateName
field.description: State name (United States on the national record)

field.name: month
field.description: The latest month in the CFPB's files (YYYY-MM)

field.name: status
field.description: P: the CFPB's own published figure

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Percent of mortgages 90 or more days delinquent in the latest month (the same as pct_90plus)

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: pct_90plus
field.description: Percent of mortgages 90 or more days delinquent, latest month

field.name: pct_90plus_year_ago
field.description: The same, twelve months earlier

field.name: change_90plus_pts
field.description: Change over the twelve months, in percentage points

field.name: pct_30_89
field.description: Percent of mortgages 30 to 89 days delinquent, latest month

field.name: pct_30_89_year_ago
field.description: The same, twelve months earlier

field.name: change_30_89_pts
field.description: Change over the twelve months, in percentage points

field.name: peak_90plus
field.description: Highest monthly 90-day share since January 2008

field.name: peak_90plus_month
field.description: First month the highest share was reached

field.name: peak_90plus_last_month
field.description: Last month at the highest share (the same as peak_90plus_month when it held one month)

field.name: peak_90plus_months
field.description: How many months the share stood at its highest value

field.name: low_90plus
field.description: Lowest monthly 90-day share since January 2008

field.name: low_90plus_month
field.description: First month the lowest share was reached

field.name: low_90plus_last_month
field.description: Last month at the lowest share

field.name: low_90plus_months
field.description: How many months the share stood at its lowest value

field.name: months_published
field.description: Months with a published value since January 2008

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
